verdicts.reason: A3 fails: the brief makes human listen the close of Assemble, but the done-when is only a hash-and-order script exit and does not include the person's listen and accept (that appears only in the gate field), while the tool is 'none' even though the done-when names a python3 script.

All rules hold: an exit-code check covers the hook only and requires a rule-named asset, which rules out a new theme; 'hook: absent' passes as a valid result; the status is assisted; and checkRunnable is false because no audio checker exists under desk/ or fixtures/.
A3 fails: the script exits 0 on every completed run, so it never enforces 'list wins' or 'do not guess', and an output with a guessed pronunciation for an unlisted name would still pass.

All rules hold: a state-diff script checks that samples outside the region are unchanged, the take is kept and a listen note exists for the region; a no-op cut passes; the status is assisted; and checkRunnable is honestly false because no checker exists under desk/ or fixtures/.
